skill.summary: 1688 商品一键操作 —— 提供商品快速修改能力，支持一键修改标题、主图和发布会员号动态。 工具能力：修改商品标题、修改商品主图、发布会员号动态，传入商品ID和新内容即可完成操作。 触发词：修改标题、改标题、换标题、修改主图、换主图、一键修改、商品修改、发动态、会员号动态、私域营销、上新通知。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of 1688-item-one-click skill:

- Provides one-click item operations for 1688: modify product title, main image, and publish Member post.
- Introduces a strict 2-step process: before_check (pre-check, including agreement signing), then execute (perform change after user confirmation).
- Supports title, main image, limited-time discount, and Member post editing via CLI.
- Enforces safe workflow—no write operations unless before_check passes and user confirms.
- Includes CLI commands, full usage guides, output formats, failure handling instructions, and environment variable/configuration documentation.
